newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says markets, low base help trading.
newsitem.headline: ING says markets, low base help trading.

text.p: ING Groep NV (ING) said favourable markets and a low comparison produced a substantial rise in financial transactions profits in the nine months to September 30.
The result jumped 52.7 percent to 936 million guilders, with securities trading profits soaring 171.5 percent to 725 million.
But foreign exchange trading profits fell 41.5 percent to 100 million guilders and other results lost 36.6 percent to 111 million guilders.
"Favourable market conditions contributed to the increase of the result from the securities trading portfolio," it said.
"Another factor was that the result for the first nine months of 1995 was relatively low due to the aftermath of the Mexican peso crisis.
"The decrease of the result from the foreign exchange trading portfolio relates to the incidentally high result in the third quarter of 1995.
"Other results also showed a decrease due to the higher results from the trade in off-balance sheet instruments," ING added.
